messages:
lisa.partners: quick sync — CloudForge HW launch next Tue. we need a stripped-down SEV path for partner-triggered incidents. shared channel + fast bridge + single pager owner. can we agree on a tiny checklist?
adam.sre: yes. minimal = shared-channel, bridge link, primary + fallback oncall, runbook link, start/stop signal. keep it under 5 steps. :+1:
neha.support: can we add expected response SLAs? partner-support gets 15m ack, eng gets 30m for triage unless emergency.
oliver.prod: agree on SLAs. also need gated escalation for customer-impacting perf regressions vs non-customer-visible issues.
andre.integration: note: CloudForge wants us in their vendor portal, they will page both support and partner channel. we should avoid duplicate bridges. prefer a single shared-channel named per rules below.
jen.partnerships: proposal for channel name and invite pattern:
```
#shared-partner-cloudforge-sev-{env}
invite: cloudforge-liaison, lisa.partners, neha.support, adam.sre, andre.integration, oncall-rotation
```
use {env}=staging|prod.
ops-bot: reminder: auto-bridge flow when channel topic contains "SEV" — run `/make-bridge --ttl 4h --record` in channel.
adam.sre: bridge template (copy into channel):
```
Bridge created: https://call.example/bridge-<id>
Command to create: /make-bridge --topic "CloudForge SEV" --ttl 4h
Roles: primary-eng: @adam.sre, primary-support: @neha.support, partner-liaison: @jen.partnerships
```
neha.support: escalations: if no ack in 15m, ping oncall-rotations-bot and DM primary-eng lead. If no triage in 30m escalate to ENG-SRE lead.
oliver.prod: add a short triage script for partner channel initial message so partner knows we saw it. e.g.
`lisa.partners: Thanks — we’ve got this. Triage started. Primary: @neha.support (15m). Eng oncall: @adam.sre (30m). Bridge: <link>`
andre.integration: for hardware incidents include these quick fields in first post: HW serial, manifest version, region, observed error string, uptime. reduces back-and-forth.
jen.partnerships: onboarding doc link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-sev-playbook — pls review. I’ll update with CloudForge-specific notes (contact matrix + vendor paging numbers).
adam.sre: also recommend a very small fallback model: if shared-channel fails or partner can’t join, run a 3-party conference: partner rep + oncall + partnership rep. put the conf link in the runbook.
oncall-rotations-bot: FYI — scheduled oncall: week 2025-03-02 primary @adam.sre, backup @zara.sre.
jen.partnerships: can someone own the pre-launch drill? 30m dry-run 48h before launch to exercise join, bridge create, and role pings. volunteer?
adam.sre: i can run the drill w/neha. will post checklist and invite CloudForge liaison.
neha.support: adding checklist items here:
- create shared channel + topic
- run `/make-bridge` and verify recording
- post triage script + required HW fields
- confirm partner paging config
- verify contact escalation numbers (phone + slack)
- dry-run join + ack within 15m
jen.partnerships: perfect. i'll lock in time and CC partner liaison.
ops-bot: incident template saved to channel topic: "Partner SEV playbook: /runbook partner-sev; Bridge: /make-bridge"
lisa.partners: thanks everyone. last ask — add a tiny postmortem template for partner-facing comms: 1-sentence impact, cause, mitigation, next steps, ETA for fix, what partner should expect. keep concise.
adam.sre: agreed. i'll add to runbook and tag you when done.
ops-bot: log: thread archived to partnerships/wip on 1745550599.
